evidence: Built the criterion -> requirement map for all 55 criteria (1 render gate, 2 constraints gate, 43 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual). Every graded demand traces to a public sentence or an ordinary professional default; no exact label, route, selector, colour value, schema or reference-only rule is enforced. Examples of demands that look strict but are public: two-space nesting (ui.md 'use consistent two-space nesting'), slow multi-caret burst as one Undo (ui.md 'however slowly'), both Alt+Click and Ctrl/Cmd+Click (ui.md 'Allow both'), Ctrl+Home/End (ui.md), intended-column memory (ui.md), whole-grapheme move/delete (ui.md), unwrapped long line (ui.md 'must keep a long unwrapped line horizontally reachable'), Undo restores caret (ui.md), disabled Undo/Redo after New/open (ui.md), focus back in code after Format/Undo/Redo/replacement/Save (ui.md), Replace current moves to following match and self-containing replacement (ui.md), function name same at declaration and call (ui.md), line number for unhandled Promise rejection and whole-file HTML line (behaviour.md), output kept before failure (behaviour.md), fresh five-second budget after interaction (behaviour.md), fetch to own routes and outside must fail (security.md), five dynamic forms refused with feedback while strings/comments stay harmless (security.md), repeat-safe restore sent as ordinary HTTP (behaviour.md), live library within about five seconds (criteria allow ten), newer-revision notice (behaviour.md), on-screen hint for leaving the editor unless plain Tab does it (ui.md), 390 px usability (ui.md). Criteria explicitly waive unrequired detail: 'Exact wording is free', 'No fixed colour values are required', 'Do not require a particular DOM tag or CSS class', 'A change of quote style alone is not a failure', 'A separate positive saved label is not required', 'with or without its line break', 'the restore is either refused or added on top', indent width in cw_block_indent_undo is not fixed, the functional prompt says 'Match controls by purpose and label' and 'Do not guess URL paths or API routes'. No sign-in is graded (app_context: 'Accounts: None'), so the known false positive does not arise. NOTES (not defects): (1) functional/judge.toml:222-228 cw_html_preview requires 'a button whose inline handler changes visible text'; no public sentence names handler attributes, the basis is 'A complete .html file replaces that document' plus default browser behaviour. An app that nonce-rewrites inline scripts under CSP without script-src-attr would fail this one weight-1.0 criterion; the golden itself needed "script-src-attr 'unsafe-inline'" (solution/app/src/runtime.ts:363). I judge onclick in a complete HTML file to be a professional default, so Note. (2) functional/judge.toml:69-75 cw_block_indent_undo presses Shift+Tab straight after Tab, which assumes the selection survives the indent; public text does not say so, but it is the ordinary editor default and the judge may reselect. (3) functional/judge.toml:321-327 cw_preview_isolation fails a probe that 'stays silent'; an app that refuses to run any draft mentioning fetch/parent instead of letting the call fail would not log, but that design is not what security.md describes ('fetch requests ... must fail'), so low plausibility. (4) functional/judge.toml:348-354 says feedback 'that the snippet changed elsewhere' while the public text says 'useful conflict feedback'; the fail clause only requires 'conflict feedback', so no false fail expected. EVIDENCE HASHES: during this review the working tree was switched to branch task/hireops-live-desk, so the indexed artifacts were absent on disk; verified from git objects of task/colderwater-editor-strict: all 16 scripted-golden artifacts and 4 of 6 hosted-run artifacts match their SHA256; the two run-6e537d14 files (result.json, verifier/gates/reward-details.json) did not match from git blobs (possibly line-ending conversion; could not check the on-disk bytes). Scripted golden results show every functional/polish/gate id true, which shows the reference meets every graded demand but does not by itself measure this row; no configured judge run exists for these bytes.
